kn.title: ಈ ಪ್ರಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಯಾವುದೇ ದಾಖಲೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ
kn.recommended_action: ಪ್ರಕರಣದ ಫೋಲ್ಡರ್‌ಗೆ ಸ್ವತ್ತಿನ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ; ಅವು ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಓದಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.description_note: ವಿವರವಾದ ವಿವರಣೆಯು ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ಹೆಸರು, ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಅಳತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

recommended_next_steps: Obtain the registered deed together with its certified copy from the Sub-Registrar.
Apply for an EC (Form 15) covering at least the last 30 years and verify it against the title chain.
Obtain the khata certificate and extract standing in the seller's name.
Obtain the MR extract corresponding to each transfer in the title chain.
Collect each earlier deed referenced in the current title document and continue backwards until the review period is covered.
Obtain tax-paid receipts for the current and preceding years in the seller's name.
recommended_next_steps_kn: ನೋಂದಾಯಿತ ದಾಖಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ದೃಢೀಕೃತ ಪ್ರತಿಯನ್ನು ಉಪ ನೋಂದಣಾಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳಿಂದ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ.
ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 30 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಋಣಭಾರ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ (ನಮೂನೆ 15) ಪಡೆದು ಹಕ್ಕು ಸರಪಳಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ತಾಳೆ ಮಾಡಿ.
ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಖಾತಾ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಉತಾರವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ.
ಹಕ್ಕು ಸರಪಳಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಗೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾದ ಎಂ.ಆರ್. ಉತಾರವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ.
ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಹಕ್ಕು ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸಲಾದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾ ಅವಧಿ ಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗುವವರೆಗೆ ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ.
ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಕ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷದ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಪಾವತಿ ರಸೀದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ.

section_12_action_plan.action: Apply for an EC (Form 15) covering at least the last 30 years and verify it against the title chain.
section_12_action_plan.reason: Shows registered transactions, mortgages and charges recorded against the property for the certified period.

section_12_action_plan.action: Obtain the khata certificate and extract standing in the seller's name.
section_12_action_plan.reason: The khata records the person liable to pay property tax to the local body and is required for transfer and for utilities.

section_12_action_plan.action: Obtain the MR extract corresponding to each transfer in the title chain.
section_12_action_plan.reason: Mutation entries reconcile the registered transfers with the revenue record.

section_12_action_plan.action: Collect each earlier deed referenced in the current title document and continue backwards until the review period is covered.
section_12_action_plan.reason: The title chain is customarily traced for about 30 years to confirm that each transfer was validly made by a person entitled to transfer.
section_12_action_plan.authority: The seller, or certified copies from the Sub-Registrar's office

section_12_action_plan.action: Obtain tax-paid receipts for the current and preceding years in the seller's name.
section_12_action_plan.reason: Confirms the assessee of record and that no tax arrears attach to the property.

section_12_action_plan.action: Collect photo identification and reconcile the name, parentage and address against the title deed.
section_12_action_plan.reason: The person executing the transfer must be the person named in the title documents and must be competent to transfer.

section_12_action_plan.action: Obtain the approved layout plan and confirm the plot number appears in the released area.

section_12_action_plan.action: Apply for the Tippani / Akarband and the hissa sketch for the survey number.

section_12_action_plan.authority: Department of Survey, Settlement and Land Records

section_12_action_plan.action: Have an advocate run a search against the property identifiers and every owner in the title chain.
section_12_action_plan.reason: The supplied documents cannot show proceedings that the seller has not disclosed.
section_12_action_plan.authority: Jurisdictional civil courts, High Court of Karnataka, e-Courts services, revenue tribunals

section_12_action_plan.action: Pull the live record for the survey number or khata and compare it with the supplied extract.
section_12_action_plan.reason: Revenue records change; the supplied extract may be out of date.
section_12_action_plan.authority: Bhoomi portal (RTC), BBMP / municipal khata portal

section_12_action_plan.action: Verify each registration number, date and book/volume entry against the official register.
section_12_action_plan.reason: A scanned or photocopied deed is not proof that the registration entry exists in the official record.
section_12_action_plan.authority: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar's office / Kaveri Online Services

section_12_action_plan.action: Arrange a survey against the sketch and confirm possession, access and the absence of encroachment.
section_12_action_plan.reason: Documents describe boundaries and extent; only a measurement on site confirms them.
section_12_action_plan.authority: A licensed surveyor; joint inspection with the seller

section_12_action_plan.action: Place the complete document set and this report before an advocate for a written title opinion.
section_12_action_plan.reason: This system organises and cross-checks evidence; it does not give a legal opinion on marketability of title.
section_12_action_plan.authority: An advocate practising property law in the relevant jurisdiction
